description: Every Pinecone API feature, plus local sync, snapshot history, and text-first search no other Pinecone tool has.

novel_features.name: Text query (embed→query pipe)
novel_features.description: Search a dense index with a natural-language query — embeds the text via Pinecone Inference, then queries the index — without managing vectors yourself.

novel_features.name: Index snapshot + diff
novel_features.description: Capture a point-in-time state of any index (per-namespace vector counts, dimension, metric, host) into local SQLite, then diff against prior snapshots to see exactly what changed.

novel_features.name: Stale-chunk pruning
novel_features.description: Find vectors whose local metadata timestamps are older than a threshold and delete them in batches — dry-run by default, with --apply to commit.

novel_features.name: Cross-index cascade search
novel_features.description: Run one semantic query across multiple indexes and merge the ranked results (deduped by vector ID, best score wins) into a single agent-ready list.

novel_features.name: Usage / growth projection
novel_features.description: Compute vector-count growth and per-namespace distribution shifts from snapshot history, with a projection to a future horizon.

novel_features.name: Vector payload validation
novel_features.description: Validate a vectors JSON file against the index schema — dimension, duplicate/empty IDs, sparse/dense shape — before you upsert and burn write units on a rejected batch.

novel_features.name: Backup/restore coverage report
novel_features.description: Join backups, backup schedules, and restore jobs into a per-index protection matrix showing which indexes are backed up, scheduled, and restorable.
